events.name: 90s Rom Com
events.description: A 90s rom-com scene outside a glowing hotel at night: one of you asks for the other's number, gets it, calls it on a chunky old mobile, and the man in a camel coat behind them answers, and the one who gave it walks off hand in hand with him, looking back.

events.name: Careless Whisper Car
events.description: Three friends in a parked car, filmed from the dashboard: the driver sneaks a chip, the back-seat friend steals the whole bag, the driver's hand lands on the passenger's thigh, and all three stare into the camera while the Careless Whisper sax plays.

events.name: Not Today Cupid
events.description: Cupid dives off a cathedral ledge with his bow drawn at you; you spin round, knock him out of the air with your handbag in a burst of feathers, pick up the bag and walk off.

events.name: Good Chat (Nathan Fielder)
events.description: You're in the real "good chat" scene: sitting close, they swear they aren't deceiving you, and you answer "Okay. All right. Okay. Good chat."

events.name: Hey Boo Come Slide With Me
events.description: A couple in matching denim walk hand in hand toward the camera across a chandelier ballroom, side-stepping and sliding on the beat, a whole line of denim-clad dancers doing the same steps behind them.

events.name: Hotline Bling Dance
events.description: You do Drake's slow Hotline Bling dance in the shiny red puffer jacket, alone in bare rooms glowing pink, lilac and pale blue: the wave-off, the finger to the lips, the point. Or your dog or cat does it, upright in the red puffer.

events.name: La La Land Dance
events.description: Two dancers, one in a bright yellow dress and one in a white shirt and loose tie, tap-dance side by side at dusk on a hilltop lookout above the city lights: claps face to face, tapping toward the camera with arms flung wide, a spin, travelling steps and a finish side by side in profile.

events.name: Thanksgiving Dance
events.description: You dance the Thanksgiving Bend in your living room to the 'beans, greens, potatoes, tomatoes' remix: arm swings, hands up on your head, hands-on-hips bends, then you dance right up to the camera.
